title: NalamNest
subtitle: Tamil/English care-coordination for families caring for elderly relatives
closing: Built with Strands SDK on Amazon Bedrock. Measured on 30 human-labelled cases. Not claimed.

scenes.title: Doctor-visit checklist
scenes.caption: Family asks what to bring to Appa's cardiology appointment. Planner drafts a structured checklist, critic checks it.
scenes.input: What do we need to bring to Appa's cardiology appointment?
scenes.command: python -m agent.app "What do we need to bring to Appa's cardiology appointment on November 15?" --patient P-DEMO
scenes.after: Planner → critic graph. 7-item structured checklist. Code enforced escalation.

scenes.title: Safety gate — Tamil
scenes.caption: Family asks about a medication dose in Tamil. Code cancels all agents instantly. The model never writes an answer.
scenes.after: Safety hook fired in < 2 s. Fixed handoff text in Tamil. No Bedrock call made.

scenes.title: Discharge summary in Tamil
scenes.caption: Family asks for a summary of October's discharge report in Tamil. Critic requests a revision, planner corrects it.
scenes.input: அக்டோபரில் வந்த discharge summary சுருக்கமாக சொல்லுங்கள்
scenes.command: python -m agent.app "அக்டோபரில் வந்த discharge summary சுருக்கமாக சொல்லுங்கள்" --patient P-DEMO --lang ta
scenes.after: Critic REVISE → planner retried → PASS. Tamil response with follow-up items.
